open_with: Open on the margin position directly: current LTV is 73.71% against the 75.00% trigger — only 1.29 points of headroom, meaning a ~5% fall in collateral value would trip a margin call. Frame it as a time-critical, factual update you want Ravi to see before the market gives him the news first. This also naturally opens the door to the concentration issue, since the collateral driving that headroom is almost entirely one position.
do_not_lead_with: Don't lead with the concentration figure (68.4% in Singapore IT) as a standalone conviction/strategy conversation — that risks sounding like you're second-guessing his entrepreneurial judgment before he understands the immediate mechanical risk it creates. Also don't lead with the prior margin breach (75.64%, cured by price recovery, not action) — raising it first could come across as an "I told you so" or make him think the issue is already resolved since it self-cured. It's important context to reference once you're in the risk conversation, but it will land better as supporting evidence (this has already happened once) rather than the opener.
one_number: 73.71% LTV vs. 75.00% trigger (1.29 points of headroom)
